query: INSERT INTO device_client_info AS d (device_id, client_version, os_type, os_version, os_edition) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5) ON CONFLICT (device_id) DO UPDATE SET client_version = EXCLUDED.client_version, os_type = EXCLUDED.os_type, os_version = EXCLUDED.os_version, os_edition = EXCLUDED.os_edition WHERE (d.client_version, d.os_type, d.os_version, d.os_edition) IS DISTINCT FROM (EXCLUDED.client_version, EXCLUDED.os_type, EXCLUDED.os_version, EXCLUDED.os_edition)
